title: Poisoning-Based Backdoors Are Not Cryptographic
abstract: arXiv:2610.28045v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To defend against backdoor attacks on neural networks, the defender must identify the verifier function that determines whether an input is a trigger, rather than rejecting individual triggers in isolation, since an attacker can generate new triggers satisfying the same verifier faster than they can be blocked. If a backdoor verifier could be installed with the asymmetry of a cryptographic authentication scheme, in which only the attacker can produce trigger inputs while the defender cannot reverse-engineer the verifier from observations, learning-based defense would be impossible in principle. We show that no such asymmetry can arise from poisoning-based installation, in which the only verifier-dependent input to training is a poisoned dataset. The argument is a reduction. A training procedure that installs a verifier from poisoned data, so that the backdoor fires on unseen triggers while benign behavior is preserved, is itself a lear

translated_title: 基于投毒的后门并非密码学安全的
translated_abstract: 为了防御针对神经网络的后门攻击，防御者必须识别出决定某个输入是否为触发器的验证器函数，而不能只是孤立地拒绝单个触发器，因为攻击者生成满足同一验证器的新触发器的速度会快于防御者拦截它们的速度。如果后门验证器能够像密码学认证方案那样具有不对称性——即只有攻击者能够产生触发器输入，而防御者无法通过观测逆向推导出验证器——那么基于学习的防御在原则上将是不可能的。我们证明，这种不对称性不可能由基于投毒的安装方式产生，在这种方式中，训练过程中唯一依赖于验证器的输入就是被投毒的数据集。该论证采用归约方法：一个能够从被投毒数据中安装验证器、使后门在未见过的触发器上触发同时保持良性行为的训练过程，其本身就是一个学习（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过归约证明，基于投毒安装的神经网络后门不可能获得密码学认证那样的不对称性，因为任何从被投毒数据中安装触发器验证器的训练过程本身就是一个学习过程，因此基于学习的防御在原则上始终是可行的。
en_tdlr: This paper proves by reduction that poisoning-based backdoors cannot achieve the one-way asymmetry of cryptographic authentication, since any training procedure that installs a trigger verifier from poisoned data is itself a learner, implying that learned defenses remain possible in principle.
